resources.string: Local time cannot be resolved for all archive data because a meter has no assigned time zone. Set the time zone in Meter details or switch to Meter time.

These local-time boundaries cannot be resolved safely because a boundary is ambiguous, nonexistent or invalid, for example during a daylight-saving transition. Choose another boundary or switch to Meter time.
Some archive periods in this range do not contain enough timing evidence for a safe Local-time projection. They are omitted here; the raw data remains available in Meter time.
